Introduction.introductory_text: I'm a fullstack JavaScript developer with an interest in building applications that help users learn new skills.

Text.paragraph_1:
I’m a full-stack JavaScript developer at Cloudbackend, where I work on a SaaS platform built on a custom web framework developed by our sister company. 
 My work focuses on building features across the stack, with a particular emphasis on integrating database functionality into the frontend—bridging the gap between data and user-facing interfaces. 
 I collaborate closely with designers and developers to deliver reliable, user-focused solutions, and I’m always looking for ways to improve how we build and structure our applications.
Text.paragraph_2: Outside of development, I enjoy playing games, frisbee golfing with friends, and currently a heavy focus on learning Japanese.

CloudBackend.title: Web Developer
CloudBackend.location: Working as a web developer with focus on developing our SaaS platform

Portfolio.title: Portfolio - April 2025
Portfolio.summary: A modern and responsive portfolio, built with TypeScript, React, Tailwind CSS and Material UI. The portfolio showcases my education, projects and myself.

Weather App.title: Weather App - June 2025
Weather App.summary: A weather application built against SMHI’s public API. Rendering GeoJSON data using Leaflet. Built with Python, C# and Next.Js, with CI/CD setup using Github actions.

League.title: League Desktop and Web App - 2022
League.summary: A tool for enhancing gameplay in League of Legends. Providing insights into gameplay factors and collecting statistics about user gameplay. Split into a web version that offers gameplay insights and an Electron desktop application that integrates with the League of Legends game client.
